diagnosis: The API key strategy verifies the validity of the provided API key, but allows the caller to override the target account using query parameters or headers (req.query.account_id). Because it never confirms whether the API key is authorized for the overridden account, any valid API key holder can access data and execute operations on behalf of other corporate accounts.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v2/finance/ledger?account_id=acc_fortune500_corp HTTP/1.1
Host: api.paymentgateway.io
X-API-KEY: key_live_sandbox_customer_4412
